newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian stocks rebound, Pliva only loser.
newsitem.headline: Croatian stocks rebound, Pliva only loser.

text.p: Croatian stocks rebounded on Friday after a long downward trend, with drugs firm Pliva ending as sole loser of the day.
* Six of 12 active stocks rose, four fell and one was flat.
* Volume lower at 4,104 units, turnover up slightly at 2.7 million kuna.
* Top gainer hotelier Istraturist rose 10 kuna to 180, or 5.88 percent from a fortnight ago on a volume of 396 shares.
* Most actively traded issue was food concern Podravka with 1,395 shares traded, closing three kuna higher at 298.
* Loser Pliva, selling 326 shares, dipped 10 kuna to 440. -- Kolumbina Bencevic, Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
